from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyEPSData(BaseModel):
    """Extracted financial data for one company from a single document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company in the report")
    basic_eps: float | None = Field(description="Basic Earnings Per Share value for the reported period")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="Time period of the report (e.g., Q1 2024)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_eps_data: list[CompanyEPSData]
